correctness.rationale: Type-A characterization plus equal-weight parity makes the alternating interval even. The remove/insert bijection at positive height is invertible and counts unordered edges once. Ground-vertex marks have generating function C(z)^2, yielding H_m=(2m+1)C_m-C_(m+1). All admissible intervals lie strictly inside the first and final steps, giving at most (n-1)^2; the interior alternating witness attains it and the opposite phase fails at n>=3. Catalan asymptotics yield E_n~(2/3)n C_n. Exact finite cross-checks on n<=10 (direct deletion balls through n<=8) passed. The published Type-A theorem is the only non-elementary input.

value.rationale: Two-read deletion reconstruction on balanced-parentheses sources motivates the induced graph. The theorem supplies a bijective description of every forbidden pair, a complete all-n edge count in its appropriate interpretation, and a sharp quadratic worst-case degree with unique maximizer, distinguishing average (linear) and worst-case (quadratic) ambiguity. The point is graph structure and constrained channel behavior, not a known-table recomputation.
